'''El Hugeirat''' (also El Hagarat) is a [[Moribund language|moribund]] [[Hill Nubian]] language spoken in the northern [[Nuba Mountains]] of southern [[Sudan]]. It is spoken by approximately 50 people in a few families within the El Hugeirat hills, specifically in the villages of Sija, Bija, Shenishen, and Baboy.<ref name=e25/>
